_doc: Large batch L11 (Sonnet generic pass): moray-lurker, reef-eel-lord, reef-eel-tyrant, conger-brute, bog-pike, elephant-seal-bull, salt-sea-lion, giant-otter-gang, deep-octopus, kraken-spawn.

moray-lurker/f:b1.note: surge of water out of the crack

moray-lurker/f:x0.note: lunge out of the rock crack, differs from Crevice Teeth Snap

moray-lurker/f:u2.note: slips into the crevice and vanishes: puff, keeps ripple for Wet Leather

moray-lurker/f:u3.note: wet slick hide: ripples, apart from Crevice Wedge shield

bog-pike/f:b3.note: reed ambush dart: reeds, not a snare

bog-pike/f:u3.note: boot snag is a snare, apart from Pike Tail Thrash slash

salt-sea-lion/f:b0.note: keyword hit is bark, not bark-of-a-tree: lunge thrust

salt-sea-lion/f:x0.note: belly flop is a heavy blow: thump blocks

salt-sea-lion/f:u0.note: bark is a sound blast, no tag: puff, best guess

salt-sea-lion/f:u2.note: blubber roll wobbles: soft puffs, apart from Salted Blubber shield

reef-eel-lord/f:b0.note: toll is a heavy bell strike: bash, apart from Coral Coil

reef-eel-lord/f:u0.note: eel shock is electric: shock beats trip

reef-eel-lord/f:u1.note: lunge from the hole: lance, apart from Eel Shock

reef-eel-tyrant/f:b1.note: name says ripple (keyword not applied to hurt): reef ripples

reef-eel-tyrant/f:x0.note: crack is a heavy blow: thump blocks

reef-eel-tyrant/f:u2.note: slips into a crevice and vanishes: puff, apart from Reef Ripple

elephant-seal-bull/f:b0.note: trumpet gape is a sound blast: zigzags

elephant-seal-bull/f:b1.note: trumpet blast of breath: puffs, apart from Trumpet Gape

giant-otter-gang/f:x0.note: rush through the water: edge ripples, apart from Gang Pounce

deep-octopus/f:b1.note: ink jet: dark drops, apart from Ink Cloud puff

deep-octopus/f:b3.note: mimic flashes colours: sparkle, best guess

deep-octopus/f:u0.note: ink cloud: puffs, keeps its name picture

deep-octopus/f:u1.note: eight arms lash: streaks, quick moves faster not shock

deep-octopus/f:u2.note: sucker grip holds like a snare: strands
